original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 151

aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="goto", target="token_management", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="prune_response", target="123-150", metadata={"status": "success"})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="submit", target="Log Tick 150 Actions", metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Command not available in Token Management Room"})
